target_customer: Accountants, fund administrators, insurance brokers and claims processors who collect documents from clients
problem: Collecting documents from clients is a manual back-and-forth of emails and chasing; Pigeon automates collection, AI review, data extraction and syncing to CRMs or storage.

founders.name: Adam Bulow
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as ex-Google data scientist. Education not found.

founders.name: Adam Sharf
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as ex-Harvard Law School without saying whether as student or staff, so education is left null.

technical_complexity.rationale: Checklist-based upload portals are standard web work; AI extraction later relied on off-the-shelf models.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations with CRMs and client workflows add some stickiness, but the core feature set was easy to copy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent copying or buying Pigeon; these names are not sourced as competitors and are listed only as category incumbents.

market_need_then: The YC launch post pitched it as DocuSign for document collection, letting clients upload into a secure checklist without an account.

brand_strength.rationale: A carrier-pigeon metaphor fits sending and fetching documents, but the name is shared with many other Pigeon companies including another YC company.

pivots.to: Full document lifecycle automation with AI review and extraction
pivots.why: Current YC description is broader than the launch post; timing not sourced

outcome_analysis: Pigeon appears to be a small, still active team of about five with an expanding AI document pitch and an open lead engineer role. No funding, customers, acquisition or shutdown could be verified from sources, so its trajectory is unknown rather than failed or successful.
notes: Aggregators claim $3.5M (VCBacked, April 2023) or $3M (StartupIntros, May 2022); these conflict, are aggregator-only and are unverified, so no round is recorded. The company site redirected to pigeonfollowups.com which returned no usable content. No dated competitor source was found. A different Pigeon (YC W22 lending) exists and was excluded. UPDATE (completeness pass): the company's own YC job listing says Pigeon closed a $3.5M seed after YC, and VCBacked dates a $3.5M seed to April 2023, so one seed round (2023-04, $3.5M) is recorded; the job listing is a company statement, the date rests on VCBacked. A $3M May 2022 StartupIntros entry and a FundedIQ $500K pre-seed (pigeondocuments.com, a founder named Rohin Bhargava) conflict and likely describe other companies, so are not recorded. Co-founder Adam Sharf was not corroborated by the search.
